faqData.question: Can I bring a plus one?
faqData.answer: Kindly please inform us beforehand. Only guests whose names are on the official list will be allowed to enter.

faqData.question: Who can I contact for concerns or messages?
faqData.answer: For any questions, concerns, or messages, feel free to chat me anytime.

faqData.question: Do I need to confirm my attendance?
faqData.answer: Yes, you can answer the RSVP through the link provided on or before July 30, 2026.
